description: HesabYar Phase 1 (per design-eng.md §17): platform foundation. FastAPI app + OpenAPI, Alembic migrations for API keys/audit/engine mapping/inbox-outbox/idempotency, API-key auth + permission middleware, application use cases over the Phase 0 Tryton adapter port, and authenticated REST endpoints for companies + accounts. Builds on branch ralph/phase-0 (adapter spike, Tryton 8.2.3 + PostgreSQL 16 running locally). Spec: ~/workspace/user/files/design-eng_0_zaup.md (§6, §7, §9, §14). Exit criteria: an authenticated scoped API client can read Tryton company/account metadata through HesabYar.

acceptanceCriteria: FastAPI added to dependencies (pinned in uv.lock); app factory creates the versioned API under /api/v1 with generated OpenAPI docs

GET /api/v1/health returns service status; readiness endpoint checks HesabYar DB + Tryton adapter health; admin-only migration-status endpoint reports Alembic revision, Tryton release and installed modules (reports state only — never runs DDL)
Every response carries X-Request-ID; errors use one consistent typed problem-details envelope; no stack traces, DB URLs or Tryton internals leak
App boots via uvicorn and serves the endpoints live in tests (TestClient or live server)
Ruff, Pyright and the full test suite pass
userStories.description: As a developer I want a running FastAPI application with health and status endpoints, so the platform has a real HTTP surface to build on.
userStories.notes: Coordinator-verified 2026-11-16: commit 832cd77; 18 tests pass, ruff pass, pyright 0 errors, live uvicorn smoke test by coordinator (health 200 + x-request-id, readiness ready, OpenAPI paths, 404 problem envelope). Admin guard on /installation is a placeholder token (US-103 to replace); Tryton release via read-only JSON-RPC common.server.version (REST exposes no version).
userStories.title: FastAPI app skeleton + health/readiness/status endpoints

acceptanceCriteria: Alembic migrations create: api_clients, api_keys (prefix + secure hash, scopes, company restriction, expiry, revocation), audit_events (+ subjects), engine_connections, engine_companies, external_id_map, inbox_events, outbox_events, integration_cursors, integration_attempts, idempotency_records

Unique constraints per design-eng §10.4: (source_system, source_store_id, source_event_id), (installation_id, operation, idempotency_key), (source_system, external_entity_type, external_entity_id, target_engine)
No SQL foreign keys into Tryton's database; Tryton IDs are stored as external references only
Fresh-install test: upgrade head on an empty DB creates all tables; downgrade back works (roundtrip tested in CI style)
Ruff, Pyright and the full test suite pass
userStories.description: As the platform I want the foundation tables created by versioned migrations, so API access, audit and reliable event delivery have durable storage.
userStories.notes: Coordinator-verified 2026-11-16: commit 5558320; 38 tests pass (migration roundtrip + schema), alembic at 0004 head, all 14 tables present in hesabyar_test, ruff pass, pyright 0 errors (all re-run fresh by coordinator).
userStories.title: Alembic migrations: API keys, audit, engine map, inbox/outbox, idempotency

acceptanceCriteria: Application query services exist for list_companies, get_company and get_chart_of_accounts, calling ONLY the engine-neutral AccountingEnginePort (no Tryton imports in application/domain layers)
Services return engine-neutral views (CompanyRef, AccountView) with stable error translation; Tryton failures become HesabYar application errors
Unit tests pass against a fake port; contract tests pass against the live Tryton 8.2.3 test server via the Phase 0 adapter
No REST/FastAPI/SQLAlchemy code in the application services; no ORM objects escape repository boundaries
Ruff, Pyright and the full test suite pass
userStories.description: As the platform I want application use cases over the adapter port, so REST, MCP and workers all share one implementation of company/account reads.
userStories.notes: Coordinator-verified 2026-11-16: commit 2309573; 22 tests pass (16 unit + 6 contract, live Tryton), ruff pass, pyright 0 errors, no forbidden imports in application layer (all re-run fresh by coordinator).
userStories.title: Application use cases: companies + accounts over the port

acceptanceCriteria: Key generation produces high-entropy keys shown exactly once; only prefix + keyed HMAC-SHA-256 hash (server-side pepper) is stored; comparison is constant-time
Rotation and revocation work; revoked/expired keys are rejected; last-used is recorded
FastAPI dependencies enforce granular scopes (company:read, account:read, ...) and company restriction; missing auth → 401, insufficient scope → 403
Keys never appear in logs, URLs, error responses or frontend bundles
Ruff, Pyright and the full test suite pass
userStories.description: As the platform owner I want scoped API-key authentication with rotation and revocation, so integrations get least-privilege access that can be cut off.
userStories.notes: Coordinator-verified 2026-11-16: commit e97cd70; 48 auth tests pass (30 core + 18 REST), full suite 377 passed, ruff pass, pyright 0 errors (all re-run fresh by coordinator). Placeholder admin_token deleted; /installation now requires settings:manage scope.
userStories.title: API-key auth + permission middleware

acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/companies, GET /api/v1/companies/{company_id}, GET /api/v1/accounting/accounts, GET /api/v1/accounting/accounts/{account_id} are live, wired to the US-104 use cases behind US-103 auth, and appear in OpenAPI
End-to-end test with a real issued key + live Tryton server: a scoped client reads company and account metadata through HesabYar (Phase 1 exit criteria)
Wrong-scope key → 403; no key → 401; unknown company/account → typed 404
Cursor pagination + allowlisted filtering/sorting on list endpoints per design-eng §9.1
Ruff, Pyright and the full test suite pass
userStories.description: As an integration client I want authenticated REST endpoints for companies and accounts, so I can read Tryton metadata through HesabYar without touching any database.
userStories.notes: Coordinator-verified 2026-11-16: commit 7253a8a; 33 tests pass (27 + 6 live e2e), full suite 410 passed, ruff pass, pyright 0 errors (all re-run fresh by coordinator). Phase 1 exit criteria MET.
